definitions.explanation: An alphanumeric code that identifies a specific model or version of a product. Essential for ordering replacement parts, comparing products, or seeking support.

examples.japanese: {型番|かたばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{型番|かたばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏面|うらめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いてあります→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The model number for this product is written on the back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}する→依頼する：21376_irai⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{型番|かたばん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{伝|つた}え→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When requesting a repair, please provide the model number and serial number.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧ (model, type) + ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (number). A practical term used in retail, manufacturing, and customer service. Knowing the {型番|かたばん} is essential when buying replacement parts, getting repairs, or comparing product specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {型番|かたばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look up the model number
- {型番|かたばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to verify the model number
- {型番|かたばん}⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧: model number search
- ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧{型番|かたばん}: old model number

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {品番|ひんばん}: product number — used more in retail and inventory contexts
- ⟦{製造|せいぞう}→製造：03289_seizou⟧⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: serial number — unique to each individual unit, unlike {型番|かたばん} which is shared across all units of the same model
- {型式|かたしき}: model type — a more formal/technical designation, common in automotive contexts
